document.title: Caste System | Hindu Jati Ke Patan Ka Karan by B R Ambedkar
document.author: Shri B R Ambedkar

content.full_text: Dr. B.R Ambedkar explains that the caste system was one of the foremost reasons why the Hindu religion and consequently India suffered a decline in the middle ages. This essay by Ambedkarji has been translated by Pandit Shriram Sharma Acharya.
content.summary: Dr. B.R Ambedkar explains that the caste system was one of the foremost reasons why the Hindu religion and consequently India suffered a decline in the middle ages. This essay by Ambedkarji has been translated by Pandit Shriram Sharma Acharya.
